@title ArbitrageExecutorTwoLeg
 @notice Two-leg arbitrage executor with Balancer V2 flash loan
 @dev Supports: TokenA -> DEX1 -> TokenB -> DEX2 -> TokenA
 ## Router ABI (AUDIT #4)
 The executor calls Uniswap **SwapRouter02**
 (`0x68b3465833fb72A70ecDF485E0e4C7bD8665Fc45`) using the struct-based
 `exactInputSingle`:
 ```text
 exactInputSingle((address,address,uint24,address,uint256,uint256,uint160))
 selector = 0x04e45aaf
 ```
 The struct has **7 fields — there is NO deadline field** (deadlines were
 removed from SwapRouter02). Calldata layout (260 bytes):
 ```text
 [0..4]      selector  0x04e45aaf
 [4..36]     0x20      offset to the struct
 [36..68]    tokenIn
 [68..100]   tokenOut
 [100..132]  fee           (uint24, right-aligned in the word)
 [132..164]  recipient     (address, left-padded)
 [164..196]  amountIn
 [196..228]  amountOutMinimum
 [228..260]  sqrtPriceLimitX96 (0 = no limit)
 ```
 ## Net profit accounting (AUDIT #5)
 `execute()` snapshots the loan-token balance BEFORE the flash loan and
 stores it inside `userData`. Profit is computed inside the callback as
     profit = balAfter - balanceBefore - repayment
 so any pre-existing executor token balance is excluded: only tokens
 generated by leg1+leg2 during THIS execution count as profit.
 The profit is persisted in `lastProfit` storage and returned to the
 caller by `execute()`.

@notice Net profit of the most recent successful execution
 (excludes pre-existing balances, flash-loan principal and fees)
